concepts.label: Chip in the line
concepts.position: A small 'Pasting…' chip sits at the paste's spot with its own ✕; what you type after it looks like normal input; the composer hint says esc cancels

concepts.label: Shimmer + floating tag
concepts.position: A shimmering bar holds the spot with a tag floating above it ('Copying from your other device · esc'); keys typed after it are dim and dotted until they're sent

concepts.label: Text marker + header status
concepts.position: A plain-text [pasting…] marker in the line, like typed text; the status and Cancel live in the pane's header, out of the line
